name: Yerba Buena Island
text: Yerba Buena Island (Spanish: Isla Yerba Buena) sits in San Francisco Bay within the borders of the City and County of San Francisco. The Yerba Buena Tunnel runs through its center and connects the western and eastern spans of the San Francisco–Oakland Bay Bridge, linking the city with Oakland, California. Treasure Island is connected by a causeway to Yerba Buena Island.

depictions.name: Yerba Buena Island
depictions.text: Yerba Buena Island (also known as Treasure Island) is an island and World Location in Watch Dogs 2.
